title: Update our Npcap URLs.
description:
The official Npcap web site is now https://npcap.com/. Update our URLs
to match. Fixes #17838.

notes.body: Backport?  (The only possible issue I see is that we've removed references to WinPcap.)
We should at least backport to 3.6. Done in !5776.

commits_data.title: Update our Npcap URLs.
commits_data.message:
Update our Npcap URLs.

The official Npcap web site is now https://npcap.com/. Update our URLs
to match. Fixes #17838.
